ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows that about 33,900 athletic trainers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 37,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,700 jobs, with roughly 2,400 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $60,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace athletic trainers, but it will handle injury records, rehabilitation plans, and data analysis. On-site assessment, emergency care, and rehabilitation support are face-to-face work that machines cannot replace.
ai_s2_accel: AI movement analysis identifies high-risk posture
ai_s2_auto: Automatically generate rehabilitation-plan templates from assessments
Digitize injury records and progress
Automatically aggregate and analyze wearable data
Automatically monitor training-load data
ai_s3_list: On-site assessment: knowing which hand to move first and which question to ask when an athlete falls comes from practice.
Acute care: timing and technique must be correct for icing, wrapping, and immobilization.
Rehabilitation support: when an athlete's confidence collapses, you understand the body better than anyone else.
Return-to-play decisions: balancing medical needs with performance requires judgment.
Collaboration with team physicians and coaches: your observations form part of the decision chain.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 means documentation and data analysis form a limited share of this role and are increasingly software-assisted. Core on-site assessment and rehabilitation guidance depend on expertise and experience, leaving limited room for AI replacement.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean the role stays unchanged. AI handles data, plans, and records so trainers can spend more time on assessment and support. Assistant roles limited to template-based exercises face pressure, while professional trainers who assess, provide emergency care, and exercise judgment become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: To enter this field, study sports rehabilitation or kinesiology and obtain an athletic training or sports-protection credential. Build strong anatomy, assessment, and emergency-care skills because data cannot replace them.

Use wearables and rehabilitation software to support judgment with data. Deepen expertise toward sports rehabilitation or team medicine and build cases through team experience. Credentials and professional training unlock advancement and higher pay.

A sports or medical background helps career changers. Start as a trainee with a sports team or at a rehabilitation organization. A resume that specifies injury categories assessed and treated and the number or type of athletes supported is more useful than generic claims.

Test emergency response when hiring athletic trainers. Simulate an ankle sprain and observe the candidate's judgment process. Credentials matter, but responsibility and composure are the qualities this role needs most.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Monitor heart rate and cadence in real time
Share records with team physicians and coaches

ai_s7_trends: As wearables and movement analysis spread, athletic trainers use data to support assessment while on-site judgment remains central.
Growth in public fitness and sports rehabilitation expands the shortage of credentialed professional trainers.
Closer integration of sports medicine and competition shifts athletic trainers from treatment toward prevention.

body: Athletic trainers prevent, assess, and provide emergency care for sports injuries and guide rehabilitation. They manage injuries, recovery plans, and return-to-play evaluation as the bridge between medical care and training on a sports medicine team.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能根据可穿戴数据算出运动量风险、生成康复计划，但球员倒地抱着膝盖说「疼得不能动」时，是先冰敷还是先查韧带，靠的是你的手和判断。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年运动训练师在岗约 3.39 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.76 万人，净增约 0.37 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.24 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.03 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代运动训练师，但会接管伤病记录、康复计划和数据分析。现场评估、急救处置、康复陪伴，是面对面的活，机器替不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 动作分析识别高风险姿势
可穿戴设备监测恢复状态
视频比对辅助康复训练
损伤风险预测模型辅助决策
ai_s2_auto: 康复计划模板按评估自动生成
伤病记录与进展数字化
可穿戴数据自动汇总分析
训练负荷数据自动监控
ai_s3_list: 现场评估：倒地那一刻，先动哪只手、问哪句话，是练出来的。
急性处置：冰敷、包扎、固定，时机与手法都不能错。
康复陪伴：运动员心态崩的时候，你是最懂他身体的人。
重返决策：能不能上场，是医疗与成绩之间的权衡，得拿捏。
与队医教练的协作：你的观察是决策链条的一环。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的记录、数据分析比重不高，这些正被软件辅助；核心的现场评估与康复指导依赖专业与经验，AI 替代空间有限。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于不变。AI 帮你把数据、计划、记录做掉，让你把时间花在评估和陪伴上。真正被挤压的是「只会做模板化训练」的助手岗；懂评估、能急救、会判断的专业训练师反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想入这行，选运动康复或运动人体科学专业，考取运动防护认证。AI 时代把解剖、评估、急救学扎实——这些是数据替代不了的硬功夫。
把可穿戴和康复软件用起来，用数据辅助判断。往运动康复师、队医方向深化，多跟队积累案例；认证与专业背景是升职加薪的钥匙。
有运动或医学背景转行有优势，从运动队实习训练师或康复机构做起。简历写「评估处置过XX类损伤、负责过XX名队员康复」这类成果，比泛泛而谈有用。
招运动训练师先考应急处置：现场模拟一个扭伤场景，看他的判断流程。别只看证书，责任心与冷静程度才是这个岗位最缺的品质。

ai_s7_trends: 可穿戴与动作分析普及，训练师用数据辅助评估，现场判断仍是核心。
全民健身与运动康复需求增长，持证专业训练师缺口扩大。
运动医学与竞技结合加深，训练师从「处置」走向「预防」。

body: 运动训练师为运动员和运动人群提供运动损伤的预防、评估、急救处置与康复训练指导，负责伤病管理、恢复计划和重返赛场评估，是运动医学团队中连接医疗与训练的桥梁。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 16,300 biofuels processing technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 16,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 300 jobs, with approximately 1,600 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $61,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace biofuels processing technicians, but it will take over routine monitoring. Distributed control systems (DCS), sensors, and anomaly detection automate parameter surveillance and alarms, shifting technicians from watching screens toward managing feed ratios, responding to exceptions, and assessing equipment. People who only sit in control rooms and watch alarms face displacement, while those who handle field problems become more secure.
ai_s2_auto: Automated process-parameter monitoring
Automated anomaly alerts
Automated yield-data collection
Automated equipment-condition monitoring
ai_s3_list: Feed ratios: people determine optimization.
Exception response: people investigate on site.
Equipment assessment: people inspect faults directly.
Safety and compliance: people uphold the limits.
Accountability: on-site operations bear responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10, moderate, means this occupation has moderate AI exposure. Monitoring is automated, while feed-ratio decisions and exception response still depend primarily on people, keeping the role broadly stable.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure still carries risk. Screen monitoring is accelerated, not the entire role. People who adjust feed ratios and handle exceptions become more secure, while DCS absorbs work performed by technicians limited to control-room monitoring.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in chemical engineering and practice DCS and process operations while in school. Pure screen monitoring is shrinking in the AI era, so develop field and response skills early instead of staying only in the control room.
Advance from monitoring alarms to feed-ratio management plus exception response. Learn process operations and data analysis, and work toward a process-engineer role.
Emphasize plant and field experience and identify the process sections you have operated. DCS experience is an advantage.
When hiring, look beyond the ability to remain seated to response skills and rule adherence. Technicians who take responsibility under pressure merit high compensation.

ai_s7_trends: DCS and sensors become widespread, automating monitoring.
Feed-ratio management and exception response become core skills.
People who maintain safety become more secure.

body: Biofuels processing technicians operate and maintain biofuel production equipment, monitor fermentation, catalysis, and separation parameters, record yield and quality data, troubleshoot exceptions, and maintain safety and environmental compliance. They provide front-line technical and operational support in clean-energy manufacturing.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能自动报警，但 3 号罐为啥偏，还得技术员去现场摸管线。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年生物燃料加工技术员在岗约 1.63 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.66 万人，净增约 0.03 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.16 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.17 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代生物燃料加工技术员，但会接手常规监控。DCS、传感器与异常检测把参数盯防和报警自动化，技术员的时间从「盯屏」挪向「投料配比、异常处置与设备判断」。真正被挤掉的是只坐控制室看报警的人，能现场处置的人更稳。
ai_s2_auto: 工艺参数自动监控
异常自动报警
产率数据自动采集
设备状态自动监测
ai_s3_list: 投料配比：调优靠人定。
异常处置：现场靠人查。
设备判断：故障靠人摸。
安全合规：底线靠人守。
责任归属：运行现场担责。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——监控被自动化，但配比与处置仍主要靠人，岗位整体稳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于无风险：被加速的是「盯屏」，不是「岗位」。会调配比、能处置的人更稳，纯坐控制室的人会被 DCS 接走。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 化工打底，在校多练 DCS 与工艺。AI 时代纯盯屏在缩，早点练现场和处置，别只坐控制室。

突出装置和现场经历，写清跑过哪些工段。有 DCS 经验优先。
招人别只看坐得住，要看处置和守规。能扛事的技术员值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: DCS 与传感器普及，监控自动化。
投料配比与处置成核心能力。
能守安全的人更稳。

Clergy shift from speaking on a platform toward pastoral visits, in-person presence, and long-term relationships. Recorded-only work faces pressure, while people who listen and accompany others become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Online worship livestreaming
Recorded sermons
Automated announcement delivery
Scheduling systems
ai_s3_list: In-person presence: people receive grief and joy.
Pastoral visits: a person stands at the bedside.
Trusted relationships: people build them over time.
Ceremony leadership: people guide the moment.
Crisis comfort: people respond to the unexpected.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places this occupation in the relatively low AI exposure range. In-person care and trusted relationships remain difficult to replace, while automation mainly affects standardized delivery.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively low exposure does not mean no change. Online worship is changing participation over time, while visits and pastoral care remain human work. Clergy who stay on the platform without entering the community face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin theology or religious-studies training with extensive practice in visiting and listening. Pure sermon delivery is shrinking in the AI era, so develop the ability to accompany people early.
Move beyond platform speaking into pastoral visits and relationship building. Learn community organization and pastoral care.
Highlight pastoral-care and community experience, and describe your ministry background clearly. Religious groups value steadiness and trust.
Do not assess candidates only by speaking ability. Look for their capacity to receive and accompany people. Strong pastoral leaders are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Online worship expands and changes participation.
Pastoral visits and presence create opportunities.
Clergy who connect well with people are in greater demand.

body: Clergy lead worship and sacred rites, preach and teach, provide pastoral visits and care, and serve communities within religious organizations. They connect congregants and offer spiritual presence at major life events, forming the pastoral core of faith communities.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于没变化：线上礼拜在长期改参与方式，但探访与关怀仍留着人的位置。怕的是只站台、不进人群的人。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Command And Control Center Officers, but it will change how they command. AI greatly strengthens situational fusion, intelligence analysis, and course-of-action simulations. Officers shift from monitoring data and calculating indicators to setting intent, making decisions, and owning outcomes. AI provides broader information and faster analysis, but people still decide whether to trust it, how to use it, and who bears the consequences.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted simulation and comparison of courses of action
Automated interpretation of drone and sensor data
Faster order distribution through digital command systems
ai_s2_auto: Automated fusion and display of situational data
Intelligent screening and classification of intelligence
Digital communications records and logs
System-based management of training and assessment records
ai_s3_list: Judgment under pressure: calm decisions in contested environments.
Intent interpretation: converting a commander's intent into executable orders.
Command communication: issuing an order that multiple units can act on accurately.
Accountability: accepting responsibility for the consequences of a decision.
Operational adaptability: relying on experience when systems fail.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places command and control in the relatively low AI exposure tier. Systems strengthen data fusion and intelligence processing, but command decisions, accountability, and real-time adaptation still depend heavily on people. AI provides decision support, not decision replacement, so displacement risk is low.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively low exposure does not remove the need to adapt. Officers who understand command information systems, use AI-assisted tools, and evaluate data are more valuable in joint command and intelligent-force development.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Young people considering military command need resilience and discipline. Military academies and related programs are the main entry routes, so review admissions and physical-fitness requirements early. Information systems and command-and-control programs align closely with intelligent-force development.

Master digital command systems and take part in intelligent command exercises. Build combined expertise in joint operations and information command. Train junior officers and conduct rigorous after-action reviews so operational experience becomes organizational capability.

Veterans and candidates with related experience can transfer command-and-control and emergency-management skills to municipal emergency centers, security monitoring, or dispatch roles. In interviews, emphasize experience interpreting common operating pictures, responding to incidents, and coordinating multiple organizations.

Command roles require calm judgment and clear communication. Selection should include stress tests and realistic exercises. Strong simulations and after-action reviews let junior officers develop quickly in conditions close to operations.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Simulation and comparison of courses of action

ai_s7_trends: Intelligent command systems are increasing the technical demands of command roles.
AI is becoming standard decision support, shifting officers toward decision-making.
Combined skills in joint operations and information command carry more weight.

body: Command And Control Center Officers monitor situations and coordinate command activities in military or emergency command systems. They consolidate intelligence, assess conditions, relay orders, organize communications, allocate resources, and coordinate emergency responses.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can fuse operational data within seconds, but it cannot replace an officer's judgment about the next move or responsibility for the outcome.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能三秒完成态势融合，但「这一步到底该怎么走、责任谁来扛」——指挥员的判断和担当，机器替不了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国军用薪酬由国防部等级制（军衔+年限）决定，民用 BLS OES 不统计军事职业，本页不提供美国中位数口径；薪资参考以中国大陆代理数据为准（爱企查等公开渠道，采样 10 条，2026-08）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代指挥控制中心军官，但会改变指挥方式：态势融合、情报分析、方案推演被 AI 大幅增强，军官从「盯数据、算指标」转向「定意图、做决策、对结果负责」。AI 给的是更全的信息和更快的计算，但「信不信、怎么用、后果谁担」依然是人的事。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助方案推演与比选
无人机与传感器数据自动解译
数字指挥系统提升指令分发速度

情报信息智能筛查分类
通信记录与日志电子化
训练考核档案系统管理
ai_s3_list: 压力判断：高对抗环境下的冷静决策。
意图理解：把指挥员意图转化为可执行指令。
指挥沟通：一句口令让多方准确行动。
责任担当：为决策后果负责的魄力。
实战应变：系统失效时用经验顶上。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明指挥控制是「低 AI 曝光」的指挥岗位：数据融合、情报处理被系统增强，但指挥决策、责任担当和临场应变高度依赖人，AI 是「决策支持」而非「决策替代」，替代风险很低。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于可以松懈：信息化指挥能力是硬要求，熟悉指挥系统、会用 AI 辅助工具、懂数据研判的军官，在联合指挥和智能化建设中更受重用。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想走军事指挥路线的孩子，要过心理素质和纪律性这道关：军校或相关专业是主要入口，建议提前了解军队院校招生与体能要求；信息类、指挥控制类专业方向与智能化建设结合紧密，前景好。
把信息化指挥系统学透，参与智能化指挥训练；往联合作战、信息指挥等复合方向深耕，同时带好新人、做好复盘，把实战经验转化为体系能力。
军转或相关背景的人员，可将指挥控制、应急管理经验迁移到城市应急指挥中心、安防监控与调度类岗位；面试时突出大屏态势研判、应急处置和多方协调的实战经历。
指挥岗位核心是「冷静 + 判断 + 沟通」，选拔时重视压力测试和实战化演练；把模拟训练、复盘机制做扎实，让年轻军官在接近实战的环境中快速成长。

联合作战与信息指挥复合能力更受重视。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Bots can answer routine questions, but customer service representatives still decide which complaints need escalation, how to defuse emotions, and how to coordinate across systems.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 2.814 million Customer Service Representatives employed in 2024, projected to decline to 2.6603 million by 2034. That is a net decrease of about 153,700 jobs, with about 341,700 openings per year and a median annual wage of about $42,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace customer service representatives, but it will reduce standardized roles. Self-service tools and chatbots accelerate routine answers, shifting people toward exceptions, emotional de-escalation, second-line coordination, and key-account care. Roles limited to scripted replies face pressure, while people who coordinate and take ownership become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Self-service knowledge bases
Chatbots
Automated ticket routing
AI reply templates
ai_s3_list: Emotional de-escalation: empathy requires people.
Exception handling: people judge when to escalate.
Cross-system coordination: people navigate permissions.
Key-account care: people build relationships.
Complex complaints: people make tradeoffs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score places this occupation at moderate AI exposure in service work. Systems accelerate routine questions, while exceptions and emotional situations still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not equal high risk. AI replaces the act of delivering scripted answers, not the broader job of managing customer relationships. People who coordinate and take ownership become scarcer as productivity rises. Representatives who only recite the knowledge base face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Do not practice scripts alone. Learn ticketing systems and data early. Routine answer volume is shrinking in the AI era, so build coordination skills.
Move from answering questions to handling exceptions + developing customer relationships. Learn systems and data, then seek complex cases.
Highlight the complaint types you handled and the satisfaction results you achieved. Specify the industries you served.
Do not hire based only on a pleasant voice. Evaluate emotional stability and coordination skills. High performers who take ownership deserve stronger performance rewards.

ai_s7_trends: Self-service tools and bots expand, reducing standardized roles.
Complex complaints and emotionally demanding work continue to need people.
Customer service representatives with coordination skills and data fluency become more sought after.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 机器人能答常规问题，但哪类投诉值得升级、怎么把情绪聊顺、跨系统怎么协调，还是客服定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年客户服务代表在岗约 281.40 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 266.03 万人，岗位净减约 15.37 万个，年均产生约 34.17 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.28 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代客服，但会压缩标准岗。自助与聊天机器人把常规问答提速，客服从「答问题」挪向「处理异常、安抚情绪、协调二线、经营大客户」。真正被挤掉的是只答标准话术的，有协调力能兜底的人更值钱。
ai_s2_auto: 自助知识库
聊天机器人
自动工单分派
智能回复模板
ai_s3_list: 情绪安抚：共情靠人。
异常处理：升级靠人判。
跨系统协调：权限靠人通。
大客户经营：关系靠人养。
复杂投诉：取舍靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的服务区——标准问答被系统加速，但异常与情绪还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「答标准话术」动作，不是「客户经营」的岗位。有协调力、能兜底的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会照念知识库的客服。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 别只练话术，早点学工单系统与数据，AI 时代纯答量在缩，练协调。
从「答问题」升级成「处理异常 + 养客户」，学系统与数据，争取复杂单。
突出处理过的投诉类型与满意度，写清跟过哪些行业。
选人别只看声音甜，看情绪稳定与协调脑子。能兜底的骨干值得给高绩效。

复杂投诉与情绪岗留人。
有协调力与数据感的客服更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can dispatch haul trucks, calculate output, and monitor safety. But the angle and force of an excavator bucket still depend on the operator's feel in the cab, not a screen.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 35,800 Excavating And Loading Machine And Dragline Operators, Surface Mining were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 35,600 by 2034, a net decrease of about 200 jobs, with about 3,100 openings each year. The approximate median annual wage in 2026 is $52,500 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Excavating And Loading Machine And Dragline Operators, Surface Mining, but it is changing mine operations. Autonomous haul trucks, remote control, and intelligent dispatch are moving through pilot programs, reducing labor in some transport tasks. Excavation and loading still require on-site judgment and will depend on operators in the near term.
ai_s2_accel: Autonomous haul-truck pilots at large mines
Remote-control platforms that remove operators from some equipment
Wider use of slope monitoring and intelligent warnings
Predictive maintenance that reduces equipment downtime
ai_s2_auto: Automated production weighing and statistics
Intelligent optimization of vehicle dispatch and routes
Automated fuel and maintenance reminders
Electronic work logs and data transmission
ai_s3_list: Excavation feel: experience determines the depth and force of each bucket.
Field judgment: operators read slopes, geology, and mining conditions in real time.
Equipment awareness: operators hear faults and detect mechanical problems early.
Emergency response: operators react to mechanical failures and site hazards.
Shift handoffs: operators coordinate seamlessly with dispatch and the next crew.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 indicates relatively low exposure. Automation concentrates on management tasks such as dispatch, weighing, and records, while people still operate excavating and loading equipment from the cab. Even as autonomous vehicles spread, operators shift from driving machines toward monitoring them and responding to failures.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively low exposure does not mean no impact. As mines become more intelligent, operators who can use remote-control stations and work with autonomous systems will become central. People who only operate older equipment and do not learn new systems will gradually lose ground.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Education requirements are limited, making this path accessible to students who do not pursue further schooling. Earn the required special-equipment credential and master safety rules first. Mining pay can be solid, but conditions are demanding and often require long-term mine-site living.

Learn remote-control and intelligent-dispatch systems early and pursue higher-level equipment credentials. Progress toward Lead Operator, Equipment Administrator, or Safety Officer roles. Do not rely on one machine type; mines need people who understand both equipment and new systems.

Experience operating construction machinery, especially excavators or loaders, transfers well. Mine-related training can provide an entry route. In interviews, your equipment experience and safety record matter more than academic credentials.

Mine operators have high turnover. Retain people through transparent shifts, safety bonuses, and sound equipment. During intelligent transformation, training experienced operators on remote systems is more economical than replacing them.

Reduce drivers through automated ore transport
Warn of slope movement and hazards
Safe practice and assessment for new operators

ai_s7_trends: Autonomous haul trucks and remote-control systems enter pilots at large mines, reducing labor in transport.
Operators shift from drivers toward equipment monitors and emergency responders.
Stricter mine safety and environmental regulation makes intelligent monitoring standard equipment.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮矿山调度矿卡、算产量、盯安全，但挖掘机那一斗下去的角度和力度，还得靠驾驶室里的人凭手感找，屏幕算不出来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机器操作员在岗约 3.58 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.56 万人，岗位净减约 0.02 万个，年均产生约 0.31 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.25 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代露天矿机械操作员，但正在改变矿山的作业方式：自动驾驶矿卡、远程操控、智能调度在试点推广，部分运输环节开始少人化。挖掘、装载这些需要现场判断的环节，短期仍离不开操作员。
ai_s2_accel: 自动驾驶矿卡在大型矿山试点
远程操控平台实现部分设备无人化
边坡监测与智能预警系统普及
设备预测性维护降低故障停机
ai_s2_auto: 产量称重与统计自动化
车辆调度与路径规划智能优化
设备油量与保养提醒自动化
作业日志与数据回传电子化
ai_s3_list: 采掘手感：一斗下去的深度和力度凭经验。
现场判断：边坡、地质、矿况的实时把握。
设备感知：听声辨障、提前发现机械异常。
应急处理：机械故障与现场险情的临场应对。
班次衔接：跟调度和下一班的无缝配合。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这行的自动化集中在「调度、称重、记录」这些管理环节，真正的挖掘装载操作还是人在驾驶室里完成；即便自动驾驶普及，操作员也是从「开机器」转向「盯机器、救场」。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于不受影响：矿山智能化在推进，会操作远程操控台、能配合自动驾驶系统的操作员会成为主力；只会闷头开老机型、不学新系统的人，会被慢慢边缘化。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学历要求低，适合不想走升学路线的孩子，但一定要先考特种作业证、把安全规矩学透。矿上收入不错但条件艰苦，要做好长期在矿区生活的准备。
趁早接触远程操控和智能调度系统，考更高等级的特种作业证。往机长、设备管理员、安全员方向走，别只守着一种机型，矿上正在缺「懂设备又会新系统」的人。
有工程机械驾驶经验（挖掘机、装载机）的转行最顺，考个矿山相关培训证书就能入行。面试时强调你的实操机型和安全记录，比学历管用。
矿山操作员流动大，用「班次透明 + 安全奖 + 设备条件」留人。智能化转型期，优先培训在岗老手操作远程系统，比重新招人更划算。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: The table arrangement system can help you figure out which table to share, but the receptionist still has to decide who needs a quiet seat and how to appease a long queue.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) shows that there will be about 429,900 receptionists, breakrooms, and coffee workers on the job in 2024, and this number is expected to rise to 423,500 by 2034. There will be a net loss of about 6,400 jobs, with an average annual vacancy of about 107,700, and the median annual salary in 2026 will be about $30,400 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI won’t replace receptionists, but it will speed up reservations and table scheduling. The reservation system, intelligent table arrangement and number calling speed up the work, and the receptionist has moved from "arranging tables" to "welcoming guests, emotional comfort, on-site control, and connection between the front and back halls". What is really being squeezed out is pure table arranging and call-taking. People who are adaptable and can take advantage of the situation are more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Automatic order taking for online bookings
Intelligent table arrangement and table sharing
Calling and reminder automation
Automatic statistics of queue data
ai_s3_list: Greeting guests with greetings: feeling depends on people.
Emotional soothing: relying on others to reduce anger.
On-site control: The rhythm is determined by people.
Back-to-back connection: Information is transmitted from person to person.
Special care: Who wants to be quiet and rely on people to remember.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 shows that this profession is in the front office area with moderate AI exposure - table reservations are accelerated by the system, but there is still room for people to welcome guests and control the field.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium and high exposure does not mean high risk: what is being replaced is the action of "arranging tables and calling numbers", not the position of "welcoming guests and controlling the venue". People who are adaptable and able to take care of things are becoming more and more scarce as their effectiveness improves. What I'm afraid of are the people who only line up the tables.

ai_s5_persona.建议: The threshold for this industry is low but it relies on emotional intelligence, so practice adaptability early. In the AI ​​era, pure table arranging is shrinking, practicing welcoming guests and controlling the field.
Upgrade from "table arrangement" to "field control + connection", learn the table arrangement system, and strive to become a front office supervisor.
Highlight your service and communication experience, and write down which stores you have worked with. The store manager values ​​stability and laughter.
Don't choose a person based solely on appearance, but also on whether he or she is in a hurry. A receptionist who can control the whole situation deserves a high tip share.

ai_s7_trends: The recovery of catering is driving up demand.
The system arranges tables and people control the venue.
People who are adaptable and able to take risks are more popular.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 142,100 librarians and media collections specialists employed in 2024, projected to reach 144,500 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 2,400 jobs, with roughly 13,500 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $64,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace librarians, but it will reduce routine roles. Research and automated cataloging accelerate organization, shifting librarians from managing books toward selection, reader guidance, program design, and digital integration. Mechanical cataloging roles face pressure, while people with sound selection and guidance skills become more valuable.

Automatic research recommendations

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score places this occupation at moderate AI exposure in knowledge services. Systems accelerate routine cataloging, while people retain responsibility for selection and reading guidance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. AI replaces mechanical cataloging tasks, not selection and reader-guidance roles. Librarians who choose well and engage readers become scarcer as productivity rises; shelving-only roles face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build selection and digital skills from a library and information science foundation. Pure cataloging is shrinking in the AI era, so develop reading-guidance skills early.
Advance from managing books to selecting resources plus leading programs. Learn data skills and pursue subject-librarian work.
Emphasize service and program experience, clearly identifying the collections you have worked with. Institutions value steadiness and warmth.
Do not hire on credentials alone. Look for the ability to guide readers; staff who engage readers effectively merit stable professional roles.

ai_s7_trends: Digital resources spread as print collections contract.
Selection and reading guidance create opportunities.
People with strong reading-guidance skills become more sought after.

body: Librarians and media collections specialists lead collection development and reader services, coordinating acquisition, cataloging, systems, and programs. They use classification and research methods to support circulation and follow up on reader needs.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Research systems can find books automatically, but people still decide what to acquire, how to frame shared reading, and how to design programs.

导读设计：场景靠人编。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「机械编目」动作，不是「选品导读」的岗位。有选品力、能带读者的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会排架的馆员。

ai_s7_trends: 数字资源普及，纸本缩。
选品与导读带来机会。
有导读力的人更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Driverless forklifts can move goods around the clock, but experienced operators still decide how to stack a shipment without crushing it and how to enter a tight corner safely.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 792,500 industrial truck and tractor operators employed in 2024, projected to rise to 801,600 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 9,100 jobs, with roughly 76,400 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $46,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not completely replace forklift operators. Mixed-item picking, irregular loads, tight spaces, and unexpected exceptions still require human operation, while safety responsibility and field judgment remain beyond machines in the short term. However, AGVs and driverless forklifts are replacing repetitive, standardized warehouse transport, and this trend is irreversible.
ai_s2_accel: In-vehicle terminals receive task instructions in real time
Seamless integration with warehouse management systems (WMS)
AI vision assists load location and stacking
ai_s2_auto: AGVs replace repetitive transport along fixed routes
Driverless forklifts enter standardized warehouse zones
Automated inventory counts and system records
Intelligent planning of order-picking routes
ai_s3_list: Field judgment: unloading and loading plans for irregular cargo.
Precision operation: techniques for narrow aisles and high-bay racks.
Safety awareness: control risks from blind spots and pedestrians.
Exception handling: respond to cargo damage and equipment faults.
Process coordination: work smoothly with inventory staff and loading docks.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score places forklift operators where AI is becoming clearly involved. Automated equipment replaces standardized repetitive transport, while work requiring judgment and on-site adaptability remains with people. The transition window is already open for individual workers.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: A mid-range score means workers must change proactively. Learn to operate more vehicle types, master warehouse management systems, and handle exceptions. Moving from pure material transport toward technical operation plus process coordination is essential to avoid displacement by automated equipment.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Young people with limited formal education who want fast employment can earn a forklift credential and start work, but they should not treat it as the final destination. Study warehouse management and logistics at the same time and progress toward inventory-control or dispatch roles. Parents should emphasize safety because forklift accidents can be severe.

Expand your skills quickly. Operate multiple vehicle types, use WMS platforms, handle exceptions, and ideally learn some automated-equipment maintenance. More warehouses combine people with driverless forklifts, and workers who understand human-machine collaboration remain valuable.

A forklift credential has a low entry barrier and provides a strong route back into work. Before changing careers, recognize that this is a transition step. Plan toward warehouse management, logistics dispatch, or equipment maintenance instead of remaining in a driving-only role.

Purchasing automated equipment is the trend, but human labor remains essential during the transition. Retain workers through skill subsidies, multi-vehicle training, and transfer paths so forklift operators can see advancement from material handling into management.

ai_s7_trends: AGVs and driverless forklifts continue replacing standardized repetitive material-handling roles.
Human-machine collaboration becomes routine, shifting forklift operators toward multi-skill operation.
Warehouse automation creates new equipment-maintenance and dispatch roles.

body: Material Moving Machine Operators drive forklifts, industrial tractors, and related vehicles to load, unload, move, stack, and transfer goods. They operate machinery that supports production and logistics and keep materials moving safely and efficiently within required time limits.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 无人叉车能二十四小时不停歇地搬货，但「这批货怎么码才不压坏、这个角落怎么进去才安全」——这些现场判断，还得靠老叉车工。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年工业卡车与牵引车操作员在岗约 79.25 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 80.16 万人，净增约 0.91 万个岗位，年均产生约 7.64 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.64 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会完全取代叉车工：多品种拣选、异形货物、狭窄空间和突发异常仍需人工操作，安全责任和现场判断是机器短期内补不齐的。但重复、标准化的库内搬运正在被 AGV 和无人叉车替代，这一趋势不可逆。
ai_s2_accel: 叉车加装防碰撞传感系统
车载终端实时接收任务指令
仓库管理系统(WMS)无缝对接
AI 视觉辅助货物定位与码放
ai_s2_auto: AGV 替代固定线路的重复搬运
无人叉车进入标准化库区
库存盘点与系统记录自动化
订单拣选路径智能规划
ai_s3_list: 现场判断：异形货物的装卸方案。
精细操作：窄道与高位货架的手法。
安全意识：盲区与行人的风险把控。
异常处置：货损、设备故障的应变。
流程配合：与库管和月台的默契。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明叉车工处于「AI 正在明显介入」的位置：标准化的重复搬运正被自动化设备替代，但需要判断力和现场应变的操作依然留给人。对个体来说，转型窗口已经打开。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中分意味着必须主动求变：学会操作更多车型、掌握仓储管理系统、能处理异常情况，从「纯搬运」转向「技术操作 + 流程协调」，才不会被自动化设备挤掉。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学历一般、想快速就业的孩子可以先考叉车证入职，但别把它当终点。建议同时学仓储管理和物流知识，往仓管员、调度方向发展；家长要提醒：安全第一，叉车事故一旦发生很严重。
赶紧把技能面打开：会开多种车型、会用 WMS 系统、能处理异常，最好再学点自动化设备运维。和无人叉车共事的库区越来越多，懂人机协作的人不会被裁。
叉车证门槛低，是快速再就业的好跳板。但转行前想清楚：这只是过渡，往仓管、物流调度、设备维护方向规划，别停在纯驾驶岗。
自动化设备采购是趋势，但过渡期人力仍是刚需。用「技能补贴 + 多车型培训 + 转岗通道」留人，让叉车工看到从搬运到管理的晋升希望。

ai_s7_trends: AGV 与无人叉车持续替代标准化重复搬运岗位。
人机协同成为常态，叉车工转向多技能操作。
仓储自动化催生设备运维与调度新岗位。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can automatically identify defective parts from images and sensors, but operators still decide whether a batch's moisture is wrong or the temperature needs to be lowered.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 154,600 metal and plastic machine setters, operators, and tenders were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 148,800 by 2034, a net loss of about 5,800 jobs, with approximately 15,900 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $41,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace molding and casting machine operators, but it will take over many repetitive tasks. Automated loading, robotic part removal, and AI visual inspection are reducing machine-tending roles, shifting operator value toward setup, mold changes, troubleshooting, and production-line coordination. The truly scarce skill is the process intuition needed to keep machines producing good parts continuously and reliably.
ai_s2_accel: Automatic parameter tuning and process optimization recommendations
Flexible coordination of robots and production lines
ai_s2_auto: Robotic replacement of loading, part removal, and material handling
Digital recording and automatic saving of process parameters
AI visual inspection replacing initial manual screening
System-based production scheduling and reporting
ai_s3_list: Machine setup experience: even with the same mold and material, people must test parameter combinations.
Defect judgment: causes of flash, shrinkage cavities, and flow marks must be assessed in context.
Mold changing and maintenance skill: how well the mold is installed directly determines yield.
Emergency response: when material jams or alarms occur, operators must quickly decide what to handle first.
On-site responsibility: every part from continuous production carries the operator's reputation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 means repetitive tending tasks such as loading, part removal, and visual inspection are rapidly being replaced by automation and AI, but machine setup and troubleshooting still depend on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate risk does not mean no prospects. Pure machine-tending roles are shrinking, while operators who can set up machines, understand molds, and work with automation are more valuable. The future of this occupation is a shift from machine tender to equipment process technician.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Mold, materials, or mechanical engineering remain strong fields of study, but add automation fundamentals such as PLCs, robot operation, and inspection equipment. Operators who can set up machines and understand automation are the most secure during production-line upgrades.

Do not limit yourself to tending one machine. Proactively learn mold changes, setup, and automated-equipment operation. Use AI inspection and parameter-optimization tools and progress toward process technician and equipment maintenance roles for a completely different level of value.

Begin as an operator apprentice, first mastering loading and part removal, then learn temperature and pressure adjustment. People willing to study molds and automation can move from tending to setup in two or three years and raise their income.

When hiring operators, look beyond speed and assess willingness to learn setup and automation. Equip experienced operators with AI inspection and training to upgrade them from machine tenders to process technicians and improve retention.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机器铺设工、操作员、看护员、金属塑料在岗约 15.46 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 14.88 万人，岗位净减约 0.58 万个，年均产生约 1.59 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.12 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代铸造成型机操作员，但会接管大量重复性环节。自动化上下料、机器人取件、AI 视觉质检让「守机」的岗位越来越少，操作员的价值转向调机、换模、异常处理和产线协同。真正稀缺的，是让机器连续稳定出好件的工艺手感。

ai_s3_list: 调机经验：同样的模和料，参数组合要靠人来试出来。
缺陷判断：飞边、缩孔、流痕背后的原因，得结合现场判断。
换模与维护手艺：模具装得好不好，直接决定良率。
异常应急：机器卡料、报警时，先处理什么要反应快。
现场责任心：连续生产的件，每一件都是自己的名。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这行的重复值守环节——上下料、取件、目检——正被自动化和 AI 快速替代，但调机与异常处理仍靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中风险不等于没出路：被压缩的是纯看守型岗位，而会调机、懂模具、能配合自动化的操作员反而更值钱。这行的未来是「从守机员变成设备工艺员」。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 模具、材料或机械专业依然能打，但要把自动化基础补上：PLC、机器人操作、质检设备都要接触。会调机又懂自动化的操作员，是产线升级时最稳的人。
别只守一台机，主动学换模、调机和自动化设备操作。AI 质检和参数优化工具用起来，往工艺员和设备维护方向走，岗位价值完全不同。
从操作学徒切入，先干熟练上下料和取件，再学调温和调压。愿意学模具和自动化的人，两三年就能从看守型转到调机型，收入也上得去。
招操作员别只看手脚麻利，要看肯不肯学调机和自动化。给老操作员配 AI 质检和培训，把「守机员」升级成「工艺员」，是留住人最好的方式。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can reconstruct a three-dimensional model of the mandible in one second, but every millimeter of a surgical incision still depends on the surgeon's sense of touch.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that in 2024, about 6,100 surgeons were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 6,400, a net increase of about 300 jobs, with about 200 openings per year. In 2024, the median annual salary was ≥$239,200 (highest BLS OES bracket, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace oral and maxillofacial surgeons, but it will take over imaging and planning. AI image interpretation can mark suspicious lesions, and three-dimensional surgical planning can simulate osteotomy plans in advance, shifting surgeons from interpreting images by intuition to making data-informed decisions. Machines cannot replace the hand-eye coordination needed for incision, hemostasis, and suturing, or the judgment required when unexpected bleeding occurs.
ai_s2_accel: Digital guides and 3D-printed surgical guides support precise osteotomy
Intraoperative navigation systems guide instrument positions in real time
AI-assisted pathology evaluation of tumor resection margins
Teleconsultation platforms give community hospitals rapid access to expert opinions
ai_s2_auto: Initial imaging review: AI automatically marks suspicious lesions and anatomical structures
Automated generation of three-dimensional surgical plans and osteotomy simulations
Assistance with generating medical records and preoperative assessment reports
Automated postoperative follow-up reminders and imaging comparisons
ai_s3_list: Intraoperative touch: the feel of every incision, dissection, and suture.
Emergency decisions: calm responses to major bleeding or accidental nerve injury.
Physician-patient communication: explaining surgical risks and plans so patients understand and trust them.
Real-time recognition of anatomical variation: every face is different.
Integrated judgment: combining imaging, medical history, and physical findings into a treatment plan.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 indicates that AI is significantly transforming the preoperative phase of this occupation. Image interpretation, planning, and simulation are all high-value use cases, while intraoperative and postoperative work depends heavily on the surgeon. The score reflects changing work methods, not disappearing jobs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Maxillofacial surgeons who use digital planning, 3D guides, and intraoperative navigation perform more precise and efficient surgery and can take on more complex cases. The outdated approach of relying solely on experience to interpret images while avoiding new technology faces the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This path requires more than 10 years of investment: an undergraduate dentistry degree + master's or doctoral training in maxillofacial surgery + residency training. It suits people who truly love surgery and can accept prolonged academic pressure and surgical intensity; families need psychological and financial preparation as well.

Proactively learn digital surgery, including AI image interpretation, three-dimensional planning, and guide-assisted surgery. Participate in difficult cases and emergencies to build experience handling unexpected events, a competitive advantage AI cannot provide.

Those with surgical or dental backgrounds can enter through maxillofacial surgery residency or advanced training. Those without that background should not force a clinical path; related roles in imaging, pathology, research, or device development are viable alternatives.

Maxillofacial surgeons are difficult and expensive to train. Strong surgical platforms and research resources retain talent more effectively than salary increases alone, while complete digital surgery equipment significantly accelerates young surgeons' development.

Minimally invasive and robot-assisted procedures are entering maxillofacial surgery, improving precision and recovery speed.
Demand for facial aesthetics and orthognathic surgery is rising, making patient communication and aesthetic judgment core differentiators.

body: Oral and maxillofacial surgeons specialize in diseases of the mouth, jaws, and face. They extract complex wisdom teeth, remove maxillofacial tumors, repair facial fractures, perform orthognathic surgery, and treat temporomandibular joint disorders.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能一秒重建下颌骨的三维模型，但手术刀下去的每一毫米，都得靠医生手上的感觉。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年外科医师在岗约 0.61 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.64 万人，净增约 0.03 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.02 万个职位空缺，2024 年中位数年薪 ≥$239,200（BLS OES 最高档，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代口腔颌面外科医生，但会接管影像和规划：AI 阅片能标出可疑病灶，三维手术规划能提前推演截骨方案，医生从「看片猜」变成「看数据做决策」。但切开、止血、缝合这些手眼配合的环节，以及面对意外出血时的临场判断，机器替不了。
ai_s2_accel: 数字化导板与 3D 打印手术导板辅助精准截骨
术中导航系统实时引导手术器械位置
AI 病理辅助评估肿瘤切除边界
远程会诊平台让基层医院快速获得专家意见
ai_s2_auto: 影像阅片初筛：AI 自动标注可疑病灶与解剖结构
三维手术规划与截骨模拟自动生成
病历文书与术前评估报告的生成辅助
术后随访提醒与影像对比自动化
ai_s3_list: 术中手感：切开、分离、缝合的每一步手感。
应急决策：大出血、神经误伤时的冷静处置。
医患沟通：把手术风险和方案讲得患者听得懂、愿意信。
解剖变异的临场识别：每个人的脸都不一样。
综合判断：把影像、病史、体征串成一个治疗方案。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业的「术前」环节正在被 AI 显著改造——阅片、规划、模拟都是高价值场景；但「术中」和「术后」高度依赖医生本人，评分反映的是工作方式在变，而不是岗位在消失。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：会用数字化规划、3D 导板和术中导航的颌面外科医生，手术更精准、效率更高，还能接更复杂的高难度病例。真正被压缩的是「纯靠经验看片、不碰新技术」的老路子。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 这是条 10 年以上的长线投入：口腔本科 + 颌面外科硕博 + 规培。适合真正热爱外科、能接受长期学习压力和手术强度的人，家里要有心理和经济准备。
主动学数字化外科：AI 阅片、三维规划、导板手术。多参与高难度病例和急诊，把「临场处理意外」的经验攒厚，这是 AI 给不了的护城河。
有外科或口腔背景的，从颌面外科规培/进修切入；没背景的别硬挤临床，可以走口腔颌面方向的影像、病理、科研或器械研发配套岗。
颌面外科人才难招且培养贵，给足手术平台和科研条件比单纯加薪更留人；把数字化外科设备配齐，能显著提升年轻医生的成长速度。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 病灶自动标注与结构识别
按术前规划精准定位截骨线
实时显示器械与解剖位置
无痛高精度取模与咬合分析
跨院专家联合制定方案
术前文书与术后随访自动化

ai_s7_trends: 数字化外科成为标配：AI 阅片 + 三维规划 + 导板手术逐步覆盖颌面外科。
微创与机器人辅助手术在颌面领域落地，手术更精准、恢复更快。
颌面美容与正颌需求上升，医患沟通和审美判断成为核心差异点。

body: 口腔颌面外科医生是专门处理口腔、颌骨与面部疾病的外科医师，负责拔除复杂智齿、切除颌面肿瘤、修复面部骨折、开展正颌手术与颞下颌关节治疗。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can scan thousands of slides in one minute and automatically mark suspicious regions, but a physician still makes the final call on whether a cell looks malignant.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 12,600 physicians, pathologists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 13,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 500 jobs, with about 400 openings annually and a 2024 median annual salary of ≥$239,200 (highest BLS OES bracket, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace pathologists, but it will profoundly change slide review. Digital pathology and AI-assisted screening have entered departments: AI performs initial screening and highlights priorities, while physicians review and sign reports. The largest-volume screening work becomes lighter, but physicians retain diagnostic responsibility, difficult differential diagnosis, and clinical communication. Pathologists who collaborate with AI improve both efficiency and quality.
ai_s2_accel: Integrated analysis of molecular pathology and genetic data
Rapid AI assistance for intraoperative frozen sections
ai_s2_auto: Digital slide scanning and storage
AI initial screening marks suspicious regions
Automatic interpretation of immunohistochemistry results
Report draft and structured template generation
ai_s3_list: Differentiating difficult morphology: deciding among subtle appearances requires experience from thousands of slides.
Diagnostic responsibility and sign-off: signing a report carries legal responsibility, which AI does not bear.
Clinical communication and consultation: translate pathology conclusions for surgeons and oncologists.
Collaborative judgment with AI: people decide whether to accept or overturn an AI alert.
Molecular pathology and new-technology interpretation: people keep pace with new targets and markers.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 means AI deeply participates in a substantial share of pattern-recognition tasks. Initial slide screening, typing, and grading are AI strengths, greatly increasing review efficiency.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-to-high exposure does not mean high risk. AI increases screening throughput, while people retain final diagnosis and responsibility, amplifying scarce pathologists' capacity. Roles limited to initial screening shrink, while pathologists who perform final review, use AI, and understand molecular pathology become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Pathology is one of the few medical fields where experience steadily raises value, but returns take time. Consider the path carefully: undergraduate medicine → pathology residency, requiring more than ten years. Those who accept a slow pace and high investment gain a deep professional moat.

Master digital pathology and AI-assisted slide-review tools early, and specialize in molecular pathology or a subspecialty. Do not remain limited to routine slide review, the layer AI affects fastest.

Transitioning into pathology without a medical background is difficult. Start as a pathology technologist preparing slides and performing immunohistochemistry, then develop toward molecular pathology technology. Emphasize attention to detail and quality-control awareness.

When hiring pathologists, assess consultation ability, quality-control awareness, and willingness to use AI, not only slide volume. Providing digital pathology and AI systems raises efficiency more than simply adding headcount.

ai_s7_trends: Digital pathology plus AI assistance becomes standard, automating initial screening and shifting physicians' time toward final review and difficult cases.
Molecular pathology deeply integrates with precision medicine, shifting pathologists from morphological diagnosis toward dual morphological + molecular diagnosis.
Remote pathology and regional pathology centers emerge, allowing frontline hospitals to share expert resources through digital platforms.

body: Pathologists diagnose disease from human tissues, cells, and body fluids, issue pathology reports, conduct intraoperative frozen-section diagnosis, and participate in multidisciplinary consultations, providing the final diagnostic conclusions used by clinical departments.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can scan thousands of slides in one minute and automatically mark suspicious regions, but a physician still makes the final call on whether a cell looks malignant.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能一分钟扫完上千张切片、自动圈出可疑区域，但「这个细胞到底像不像恶性的」最后一锤，还得医生来敲。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年医师、病理医师在岗约 1.26 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.31 万人，净增约 0.05 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.04 万个职位空缺，2024 年中位数年薪 ≥$239,200（BLS OES 最高档，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代病理医师，但会深度改变阅片方式。数字病理加 AI 辅助筛查已经进科室，AI 负责初筛、圈重点，医生负责复核和签发。工作量最大的初筛环节被摊薄，但诊断责任、疑难鉴别和与临床的沟通，依然在医生身上。会跟 AI 协作的病理医师，效率和质量反而上去了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助癌种分型与分级
分子病理与基因数据整合分析
术中冰冻 AI 快速辅助
跨科室病理资料智能检索
ai_s2_auto: 数字切片扫描与存储
AI 初筛圈出可疑区域
免疫组化结果自动判读
报告草稿与结构化模板生成
ai_s3_list: 疑难形态的鉴别能力：像与不像之间，靠的是成千上万张片的积累。
诊断责任与签发：报告签字就是法律责任，AI 不背锅。
临床沟通与会诊：把病理结论翻译给外科、肿瘤科听得懂。
与 AI 的协作判断：AI 说可疑，是采信还是推翻，得人来定。
分子病理与新技术解读：新靶点、新标记，靠人跟上前沿。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业有相当比例的「模式识别」任务正被 AI 深度介入——切片初筛、分型分级都是 AI 的强项，阅片效率被大幅拉升。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 提高的是筛查吞吐量，最终诊断和责任仍在人身上，这恰恰让稀缺的病理医师产能放大。真正被压缩的是「只做初筛」的基础岗，能终审、会 AI、懂分子的病理医师更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 病理是医学里少有的「越老越值钱」方向，但回报周期长。想清楚再读：本科医学 → 病理规培，一路要十几年。能接受慢节奏和高投入，这行护城河极深。
尽早把数字病理和 AI 辅助阅片工具用熟，往分子病理、亚专科方向深耕。别只做普通阅片，那是 AI 冲击最快的一层。
非医背景转病理难，可从病理技术员（技师方向）切入，做切片制备、免疫组化，再向分子病理技术发展。简历突出细心和质控意识。
招病理医生别只盯阅片量，要看会诊能力、质控意识和 AI 工具使用意愿。给医生配好数字病理与 AI 辅助系统，比堆人头效率高得多。

ai_s7_trends: 数字病理加 AI 辅助成为标配，初筛自动化后医生把时间投向终审与疑难病例。
分子病理与精准医疗深度融合，病理医师从「形态诊断」走向「形态+分子」双重诊断。
远程病理与区域病理中心兴起，基层医院通过数字化平台共享专家资源。

body: 病理医师以人体组织、细胞和体液为对象进行疾病诊断，出具病理报告、参与术中冰冻诊断与多学科会诊，是临床各科室「诊断结论」的最终来源。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能一分钟扫完上千张切片、自动圈出可疑区域，但「这个细胞到底像不像恶性的」最后一锤，还得医生来敲。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can grade exams and create teaching materials, but teaching assistants still determine where each student is stuck and how to explain the concept clearly.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 193,600 postsecondary teaching assistants were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 199,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 6,000 jobs, with about 24,600 openings each year on average. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $44,900 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace postsecondary teaching assistants, but it will reduce standardized tasks. Automated grading of objective questions and teaching-material generation accelerate routine work, shifting assistants from marking papers toward leading discussions, answering advanced questions, and providing feedback on student learning. People who only grade objective work face displacement, while those with teaching ability become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Automated grading of objective questions
Automated courseware generation
Automated attendance tracking
Automated plagiarism checks
ai_s3_list: Lead discussions: people guide thinking.
Answer advanced questions: people break down difficult concepts.
Student learning feedback: people identify sticking points.
Laboratory guidance: people supervise procedures.
Teacher-student trust depends on human relationships.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in a moderately high exposure area of teaching. Standard grading is accelerated, but people retain an essential role in guided practice and answering questions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is grading objective work, not instructional support roles. People with teaching ability who can lead practice become scarcer as productivity rises. Assistants who only grade against standard answers face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: During graduate or doctoral study, practice communication extensively. Pure grading is shrinking, so develop course-leading skills early.
Advance from grading assignments to leading discussions plus providing feedback, and learn student learning analysis.
Highlight teaching and subject expertise and specify the courses you have supported. Departments value reliability and attention to detail.
When selecting assistants, look beyond grades to teaching ability. Core contributors who can lead practice are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Grading becomes faster.
Leading practice and answering questions become more valuable.
Student learning feedback skills command a premium.

body: Postsecondary teaching assistants prepare lessons, lead discussions and laboratories, grade assignments, and tutor students, breaking professors' large lectures into smaller sessions students can fully understand and helping knowledge truly reach them.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can grade exams and create teaching materials, but teaching assistants still determine where each student is stuck and how to explain the concept clearly.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能阅卷、能出课件，但哪个学生卡在哪、怎么讲透，还是助教定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年高校教学助理在岗约 19.36 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 19.96 万人，净增约 0.60 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.46 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.49 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代高校助教，但会压缩标准动作。客观题阅卷与课件生成把常规活提速，助教从「改卷子」挪向「带讨论、答深问、做学情反馈」。被挤掉的是只做客观批改的，有教学力的人更值钱。
ai_s2_auto: 客观题自动阅卷
课件自动生成
出勤自动统计
作业自动查重
ai_s3_list: 带讨论：思维靠人引。
答深问：难点靠人拆。
学情反馈：卡点靠人判。
实验指导：操作靠人盯。
师生信任：关系靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的教学区——标准阅卷被加速，但带练与答疑还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「改客观卷」动作，不是「教学辅助」的岗位。有教学力、能带练的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会按标准改卷的助教。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读研读博多练表达，纯批改在缩，早点练带课。
从「改作业」升级成「带讨论 + 做反馈」，学学情分析。
突出教学与专业，写清带过哪些课。院系看稳和细。
选人别只看成绩，要看会不会讲。能带练的骨干值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 阅卷被加速。
带练与答疑更值钱。
学情反馈能力溢价。

body: 高校教学助理是围绕备课、带讨论与实验、批改作业与答疑辅导，把教授的大课拆成学生吃得透的小课、让知识真正讲到学生心里的教学一线职业。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can turn account opening and transfers into self-service buttons, but a teller still has to explain why a customer holding an expired ID cannot complete the transaction.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 347,400 bank tellers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 302,500 by 2034, a net decrease of about 44,900 jobs, with approximately 29,800 openings annually. Median annual pay in 2026 is about $39,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace bank tellers, but it will sharply reduce pure counter operations. Mobile banking, smart teller machines, and RPA reconciliation take over standardized transactions, shifting tellers from keyboard entry toward exception handling, explaining rules, and managing customer relationships. Tellers who only process transactions mechanically face displacement, while those who handle complex transactions and enforce compliance become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent customer service and voice assistants that handle common questions first
Remote video tellers replacing some in-branch transactions
Real-time alerts for risky transactions to support teller judgment
ai_s2_auto: Self-service and smart-terminal diversion of standard transactions such as account opening, transfers, and inquiries
Automated reconciliation and transaction matching through RPA
OCR recognition of identity documents and receipt fields
Rule-based automated screening for anti-money laundering and suspicious transactions
ai_s3_list: Complex transactions and exceptions: People decide how to handle expired IDs, frozen accounts, and disputed transactions.
Compliance and interpersonal judgment: Reporting suspicious transactions depends on experience and responsibility.
Customer reassurance: Machines cannot absorb the emotions behind complaints and urgent needs.
Physical management of cash and documents: People still handle cash drawers and end-of-day cash boxes.
Cross-functional coordination: Integrated service connecting branch transactions, lending, and wealth management.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 indicates moderately high AI exposure in counter operations. Systems and robotic processes can replace many standardized actions, but people retain cash handling and on-site service.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Standardized actions are being replaced, not the entire role. Tellers who handle complex transactions, understand compliance, and transition into customer management become scarcer as intelligent tools divert routine work. Those who only click buttons and refuse to learn new systems face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in finance or accounting and earn banking and counterfeit-currency credentials while in school. Pure counter work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop compliance and business-explanation skills early instead of focusing only on cash counting.

Advance from processing transactions to managing customers + protecting compliance. Learn wealth management and lending, and pursue a move into relationship management or operations supervision rather than remaining in mechanical operations.

Highlight attention to detail, compliance awareness, and systems proficiency, including the complex transactions you have handled. Credentials and customer experience are preferred, while experienced hiring values stability.
Do not recruit solely for cash-counting speed. Evaluate compliance habits and service patience. Tellers who independently resolve exceptions and refer customers deserve higher performance pay.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Integrated processing of account openings, transfers, and negotiable instruments
Automatic extraction of document numbers and amounts
Automated answers to frequently asked questions
Video identity verification and transaction processing

ai_s7_trends: Smart teller machines and mobile banking continue to divert standard branch transactions, shifting branches toward consultation + complex transactions.
RPA and OCR make reconciliation and document processing nearly unattended, shifting tellers toward service and relationship management.
Hybrid tellers who understand compliance, manage customer relationships, and explain complex transactions are in greater demand.

body: Bank tellers process cash receipts and payments, deposits and withdrawals, transfers and remittances, account openings and closures, negotiable instrument settlement, and account services at bank branches. They verify customer identity and documents, operate core banking systems, and complete reconciliation.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can turn account opening and transfers into self-service buttons, but a teller still has to explain why a customer holding an expired ID cannot complete the transaction.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把开户转账做成自助按钮，但客户举着一张过期证件问「为啥办不了」，还得柜员解释。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年银行柜员在岗约 34.74 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 30.25 万人，岗位净减约 4.49 万个，年均产生约 2.98 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.93 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代银行柜员，但会大幅压缩纯柜面操作。手机银行、智能柜台、RPA 对账把标准化业务接走了，柜员的时间从「敲键盘」挪向「处理异常、解释规则、经营客户」。真正被挤掉的是只会机械办业务的柜员，能办复杂业务、能做合规把关的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 智能客服与语音助手前置分流常见咨询
客户画像驱动的产品智能推荐
远程视频柜员替代部分临柜业务
风险交易实时预警辅助柜员判断
ai_s2_auto: 开户、转账、查询等标准化业务的自助化与智能柜台分流
RPA 自动对账与交易流水勾稽
OCR 自动识别身份证件与票据要素
反洗钱与可疑交易的规则化自动筛查
ai_s3_list: 复杂业务与异常处置：过期证件、账户冻结、争议交易要人定夺。
合规与人际判断：可疑交易是否上报，靠经验和责任心。
客户情绪安抚：投诉和急事面前，机器接不住情绪。
现金与凭证实物管理：钱箱尾箱仍要人经手。
跨业务协调：把柜面、信贷、理财串起来的综合服务。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的柜面操作区——大量标准化动作能被系统和机器人流程替代，但现金与现场服务还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准化动作」，不是「岗位」。会做复杂业务、懂合规、能转客户经营的人，反而随智能分流变得更稀缺。怕的是只会点按钮、不学新系统的柜员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 金融会计类专业打底，在校把银行从业、反假货币证书考了。AI 时代纯柜面在缩，早点练合规和业务解释能力，别只盯着点钞。
从「办业务」升级成「经营客户 + 守合规」，学理财和信贷知识，争取转岗理财经理或运营主管，别停留在机械操作。
突出细心、合规意识和系统熟练度，写清处理过哪些复杂业务。有证书和客户经验优先，社招看重稳。
招人别只看点钞速度，要看合规习惯和服务耐心。能独立处理异常、能做客户转介的柜员，值得给更高绩效。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 开户转账票据一体化处理
标准化业务无人化办理

ai_s7_trends: 智能柜台与手机银行继续分流标准化柜面，网点向「咨询 + 复杂业务」转型。
RPA 与 OCR 让对账、凭证处理基本无人化，柜员转向服务与经营。
懂合规、能做客户经营和复杂业务解释的复合柜员更抢手。

body: 银行柜员在银行网点办理现金收付、存款取款、转账汇款、开户销户、票据结算与账户服务等柜面业务，核验客户身份与凭证，操作核心业务系统并完成对账。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能把开户转账做成自助按钮，但客户举着一张过期证件问「为啥办不了」，还得柜员解释。
